item.title: Molecularly guided therapy may improve outcomes in patients with unfavourable cancer of unknown primary compared with standard chemotherapy
item.description: Molecularly guided therapy (MGT) was linked to significantly better progression-free survival (PFS) than standard platinum-based chemotherapy in patients with unfavorable cancer of unknown primary.

item.title: MicroRNA Panel May Predict Early Liver Metastasis in PDAC
item.description: A machine learning model using seven exosomal microRNAs can identify pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma patients at risk for early liver metastasis.

item.title: Second-hand smoke causes nearly 1.7M deaths globally: Study
item.description: Over 2.7 billion people, including children, were exposed to secondhand smoke globally, contributing to nearly 1.7 million deaths in 2023, according to a study.

item.title: We Might Have Been Wrong About How the Immune System Ages
item.description: A rare immune cell linked to cancer resistance increases in the very old, suggesting the immune system actively adapts to extreme longevity.
